description: History is recorded by every microstep, also while settling. `B` is entered and left again in the step that takes `Go`, by an `always`; leaving `P` records `B`, and the `always` of `Q` enters `P` through its history state, so `P` returns to `B` within the same step. `B` is where `P` was at the end of the microstep before it was left, though no step ended in it.
